# Pushinator

Pushinator provides push notification channels for sending real-time alerts to subscribed users and devices.

Category: Communication. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/pushinator/.

## Actions

- **Create Channel**: Create a Pushinator notification channel and return its channel ID and properties.
- **Delete Channel**: Permanently delete a Pushinator notification channel by ID.
- **Get Channel** (read-only): Get one Pushinator notification channel by its channel ID.
- **Get Current User** (read-only): Return the Pushinator user associated with the connected API key.
- **List Channels** (read-only): List every notification channel belonging to the connected Pushinator account.
- **Send Notification**: Send a push notification immediately to all subscribers of a Pushinator channel.
- **Update Channel**: Replace the editable name and optional description of an existing Pushinator notification channel.
